note: Niva et al. (2023), net migration 2000–2019: annual net-migration rates (5′ grid, estimated as reported population change minus births plus deaths) summed over 20 years, here averaged into 10′ cells weighted by population (GHS-POP 2025) and shown as summed annual rates in percent. Positive = more people moved in than out. Clamped to ±50 %; cells with fewer than 1,000 residents left empty. The authors warn that single cells are noisy: read patterns, not pixels.
